Partial Bone Formation in Additive Manufactured Porous Implants Reduces Predicted Stress and Danger of Fatigue Failure.

Vee San Cheong, Paul Fromme, Melanie J Coathup, Aadil Mumith, Gordon W Blunn Annals of biomedical engineering 2020-01-01 10.1007/s10439-019-02369-z
单位: John Scales Centre for Biomedical Engineering, Institute of Orthopaedics and Musculoskeletal Science, Royal National Orthopaedics Hospital, University College London, Stanmore, HA7 4LP, UK.; Departmen
通讯: Paul Fromme @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, University College London, London, WC1E 7JE, UK. p.fromme@ucl.ac.uk.
相关性: 该论文直接关注增材制造多孔植入物的应力遮挡和疲劳失效问题，与本方向高度相关。
边界: It lacks LPBF mechanical characterization (e.g., fatigue testing) and surface roughness analysis; validation is based on in vivo histology, not mechanical testing.
动机· 评估多孔植入物中骨长入对应力分布和疲劳寿命的影响
方法· 使用FEA骨重塑模型预测骨形成，并与体内组织学对比
结果· 骨部分形成至少降低20%应力集中，提高大孔径植入物疲劳耐久性
验证· 羊髁缺损模型体内组织学验证
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate how bone ingrowth into porous metal implants affects stress distribution and fatigue failure risk.
Method· A phenomenological FEA bone remodeling model predicted partial bone formation for two pore-sized LPBF Ti6Al4V implants, validated against in vivo ovine histology.
Result· Partial bone formation reduced stress concentrations by at least 20% and improved fatigue resistance, especially for larger pores, bringing peak stress to 86% of fatigue strength.
Validation· In vivo ovine condylar defect model with histology comparison.

Femoral Stress Changes after Total Hip Arthroplasty with the Ribbed Prosthesis: A Finite Element Analysis.

Changqi Luo, Xiang-Dong Wu, Yifei Wan, Junyi Liao, Qiang Cheng et al. BioMed research international 2020-01-01 10.1155/2020/6783936
单位: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 400016, China.
通讯: Wei Huang @ Department of Orthopedic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing 400016, China [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接量化了带肋假体后的股骨应力遮挡率（71.6%），并比较了完整与植入后的股骨应力分布，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: No micromotion analysis, no contact/friction modeling for primary stability, no explicit Gruen zone reporting.
动机· 分析带肋假体植入后股骨应力变化及应力遮挡效应
方法· 建立完整股骨和带肋假体的三维有限元模型，施加髋关节载荷和肌肉力
结果· 带肋假体导致股骨近端应力遮挡率达71.6%，应力从远端逐渐恢复至生理水平
验证· 通过比较完整股骨与植入后的应力分布模式验证模型
English summary & terms
Motivation· To quantify biomechanical stress redistribution and stress shielding in the femur after implantation of a Ribbed anatomic prosthesis.
Method· Three-dimensional finite element models of an intact femur and a Ribbed prosthesis were constructed from morphology, with hip joint loading and muscle forces applied.
Result· The Ribbed prosthesis induced a 71.6% stress shielding ratio in the proximal femur, with stress gradually increasing distally and returning to physiological levels at the prosthesis tip.
Validation· The model was validated by comparing overall stress patterns between the intact and implanted femur.

动机· 建立骨锚式假体植入物设计与应力遮挡之间的关联。
方法· 通过有限元分析评估三种植入物设计在不同刚度下的骨质量变化。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To establish the relationship between implant design for bone-anchored prostheses and stress-shielding affecting long-term stability.
Method· Finite element analysis was used to evaluate bone mass changes for threaded, press-fit, and modular press-fit implants with varying Young's modulus (10-210 GPa).
Result· Threaded implants induced 4% more bone loss at the distal femur but overall bone loss was 5% lower compared to press-fit designs.
Validation· Numerical simulation without experimental validation.

Aadil Mumith, Vee San Cheong, Paul Fromme, Melanie J Coathup, Gordon W Blunn PloS one 2020-01-01 10.1371/journal.pone.0227232
单位: Institute of Orthopaedics and Musculoskeletal Science, University College London, Royal National Orthopaedics Hospital, Stanmore, England, United Kingdom.
通讯: Gordon W Blunn @ Institute of Orthopaedics and Musculoskeletal Science, University College London, Royal National Orthopaedics Hospital, [推断]
相关性: 论文研究了激光烧结多孔钛合金植入物的电化学涂层对骨整合的影响，但与研究方向中的应力遮挡和力学匹配无直接关联。
边界: This paper does not evaluate stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue performance, or any mechanical testing; it focuses solely on biological osseointegration via coatings.
动机· 研究离子取代羟基磷灰石涂层对多孔金属植入物骨整合的影响
方法· 激光烧结Ti6Al4V多孔植入物，电化学沉积HA/SiHA/SrHA涂层，植入羊体内6周
结果· 电化学涂层显著促进骨附着，HA涂层骨整合最高，孔径大小无显著影响
验证· 羊体内植入后组织学和组织形态学评估
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of strontium and silicon substituted hydroxyapatite coatings on bone ingrowth and osseointegration of additively manufactured porous metal implants.
Method· Selective laser sintered Ti6Al4V implants with two pore sizes were electrochemically coated with HA, SiHA, or SrHA and implanted in ovine femoral condyles for 6 weeks.
Result· Electrochemically coated implants, especially HA, significantly improved bone-implant contact and osseointegration compared to uncoated or plasma-sprayed controls, regardless of pore size.
Validation· In vivo ovine model with histomorphometric analysis.

Haotian Bai, Yue Zhao, Chenyu Wang, Zhonghan Wang, Jincheng Wang et al. Theranostics 2020-01-01 10.7150/thno.43736
单位: Orthopaedic Medical Center, The Second Hospital of Jilin University, Changchun 130041, P. R. China.; Orthopaedic Research Institute of Jilin Province, Changchun 130041, P. R. China.
通讯: He Liu @ Orthopaedic Medical Center, The Second Hospital of Jilin University, Changchun 130041, P. R. China.; Orthopaedic Researc [推断]
相关性: 该论文研究了多孔钛合金支架与生物活性水凝胶复合界面的骨整合性能，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳测试或LPBF工艺细节，与用户关注方向关联有限。
边界: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks LPBF fabrication details and mechanical testing beyond basic characterization, and does not report fatigue or surface roughness.
动机· 骨质疏松患者关节置换后骨整合不良，需设计改善骨整合的假体界面。
方法· 构建3D打印金属多孔支架与自愈合水凝胶的复合界面，负载BMSCs和BMP-2。
结果· 复合界面促进BMSCs增殖和成骨分化，在骨质疏松模型中增强骨整合并改善骨微环境。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To address poor osseointegration in osteoporotic patients after joint replacement by designing a prosthetic interface that counteracts pathological bone loss.
Method· A 3D-printed porous titanium scaffold was combined with an injectable, self-healing hydrogel loaded with bone marrow stem cells and BMP-2 to form a supramolecular bioactive interface.
Result· The composite interface enhanced cell proliferation, sustained BMP-2 release, promoted osteogenic differentiation, and improved osseointegration in an osteoporotic rat model.
Validation· In vitro biocompatibility and osteogenic assays, followed by in vivo implantation in osteoporotic rats with histological analysis.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To accurately compute the flow and shear stress distribution of shear-thinning bioinks in a cylindrical nozzle during biofabrication.
Method· Interpolating the viscosity with piecewise power-law functions to obtain an exact piecewise solution to the incompressible Navier-Stokes equation.
Result· Shear stress varies linearly from zero at the center to maximum at the wall, independent of shear-thinning properties; the method can be inverted for in-situ rheology from flow-pressure data.
Validation· Validated against analytical solutions for Carreau-Yasuda fluid, full CFD simulations for chitosan hydrogel, and experimental velocity profiles of alginate and chitosan in a microfluidic channel.

Motivation· To investigate how nanopatterned titanium surfaces influence the proliferation of osteoblast-like and epithelial-like cells for optimizing implant osseointegration.
Method· Titanium films with 500 nm grooves and pillars were fabricated via nanoimprinting, seeded with Saos-2 and Ca9-22 cells, and analyzed by proliferation assay and SEM.
Result· Osteoblast-like cells proliferated most robustly on grooved surfaces, while epithelial-like cells favored smooth surfaces, indicating differential responses to nanostructures.
Validation· Cell viability and morphology were assessed using colorimetric proliferation assays and scanning electron microscopy.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To compare the effects of two novel laser-induced titanium surfaces and a sandblasted and acid-etched surface on human osteoblast behavior during osteogenesis and early bone deposition.
Method· Human osteoblasts derived from adipose stem cells were cultured on the titanium surfaces; proliferation, mineralization, and bone matrix deposition were assessed using MTT, SEM, EDAX, RT-PCR, and Western blot.
Result· The laser-textured surfaces, particularly L2, enhanced cell adhesion and bone deposition compared to the control surface.
Validation· In vitro cell culture experiments with multiple assays (MTT, SEM, EDAX, RT-PCR, Western blot) were used for validation.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To compare the biomechanical performance of different mandibular body and ramus reconstruction methods using a free vascularized fibula flap.
Method· Finite element models of five surgical methods were created, physical models were 3D printed for stiffness testing, and postoperative cone beam CT was used to monitor bone mineral density.
Result· The 'double up' configuration provided the most favorable stress distribution and highest stiffness among the methods, with bone mineral density plateauing at 12 weeks postoperatively.
Validation· Validation was performed through finite element simulation, electromechanical stiffness testing of 3D printed models, and clinical follow-up with CBCT bone density analysis.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the subsidence rate of a novel 3D-printed porous titanium cage in minimally invasive lateral lumbar interbody fusion.
Method· A retrospective review of postoperative radiographs from 29 patients (30 surgeries) was conducted to identify any endplate compromise indicating subsidence.
Result· Subsidence occurred in 6.7% of cases and 3.4% of implanted levels, which is lower than previously reported rates for PEEK cages.
Validation· Clinical radiographic follow-up was used to validate the subsidence rate.

Motivation· Porous titanium scaffolds for large bone defects lack the physiological electrical environment, motivating the integration of piezoelectric materials to enhance osteogenesis.
Method· Barium titanate (BaTiO3) was coated onto porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds and low-intensity pulsed ultrasound (LIPUS) was applied to induce a piezoelectric effect.
Result· The piezoelectric effect significantly promoted osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow stromal cells in vitro and bone formation and ingrowth in vivo.
Validation· The study validated the approach through in vitro cell assays and in vivo implantation in an animal model.

Method· Nanoporous titanium coatings with varying magnesium concentrations were fabricated using micro-arc oxidation and characterized by SEM, EDS, and ICP-OES; biocompatibility and osteogenesis were assessed in vitro with BMSCs.

边界: No hip implant or femoral stem analysis, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no contact mechanics or FE modeling.
动机· 比较钙磷涂层与喷砂酸蚀表面在小型猪下颌骨中的骨整合效果
方法· 在小型猪下颌骨植入36枚圆柱形压配种植体，分析骨-种植体接触率
结果· 钙磷涂层种植体骨整合失败率较高，该动物模型不推荐用于种植体研究
验证· 通过2、4、8周的组织学分析验证骨整合
English summary & terms
Motivation· To compare the osseointegration of calcium phosphate-coated vs. sandblasted/acid-etched titanium implants in a minipig mandible model.
Method· Thirty-six press-fit cylindrical implants were inserted bilaterally into minipig mandibles, and bone-to-implant contact was quantified histologically at 2, 4, and 8 weeks.
Result· CaP-coated implants showed higher failure rates and no significant improvement in osseointegration over SA surfaces, questioning the model's suitability.
Validation· Histological analysis of cortical and area bone-implant contact provided osseointegration validation in an animal model.
